intro: Polygyros is the administrative capital of Halkidiki, a mountain town among pine and olive groves, with the beach villages of Gerakini and Psakoudia on the gulf below. Services stay open all year and the coast is a short drive away.
body:
Polygyros, the capital of Halkidiki

Polygyros is the capital of the regional unit of Halkidiki, built on the hills among pine and olive groves. The regional offices, the courts and the general hospital of Halkidiki are here, so the town keeps its services open in every season.

The coast: Gerakini and Psakoudia

Below the town, on the gulf, are the beach villages of Gerakini and Psakoudia, near the base of Sithonia. The beaches are long and easy, close to towns with life all year, and popular with families.

The villages inland

Inland are the villages of Taxiarchis, Paleochora, Agios Prodromos and Kalyves.

Living in Polygyros all year

Families who live in Halkidiki all year often choose the area around Polygyros, for its schools, shops and the shorter drive to Thessaloniki. For a home used in winter, check the heating, the insulation and the access in bad weather before you buy.

Buying property in Polygyros

Buying in Polygyros works like anywhere in Greece: a Greek tax number in one day, an independent lawyer, a pre-contract with a 10% deposit, the notary deed and the land registry. Count 4 to 8 weeks in total and about 6% on top of the price for taxes and fees.
